historical_record.description: The Art Commission approved the working drawings for the Hayes Valley Playground and Fieldhouse, designed by John W. Gloe, Architect.
At the formal request of Hayes Valley residents, the Recreation and Park Commission chose the southeast corner of Hayes and Buchanan Streets as the site of the district's new recreation center.
The Recreation and Park Commission engaged the architect John W. Gloe to prepare plans, specifications and cost estimates for the Hayes Valley field house and playground, for a fee of $7,950.
The Recreation and Park Commission let a $5,910 contract to Passetti Trucking Company to raze the buildings on the site of the Hayes Valley Recreation Center.

The Recreation and Park Commission let a $7,242 contract to the Cleveland Wrecking Company of Cincinnati to raze two city-owned buildings at 632 and 640 Buchanan Street, on the site of the Hayes Valley Recreation Center.
The Recreation and Park Commission awarded the contract to build Hayes Valley Playground and its field house, at Hayes and Buchanan Streets, to DeNarde & Ganske at $108,739, the lowest of seven bids.
